label: copy-phase input t (recall >= 3), strongest when the next token to output is e ("te")
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, at steps where the fed-back input is t (98% of activation mass; in_tok=e gives a little more) and the model is outputting original token 3 or later. It never fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, or for recall_idx < 3, and only at repeat occurrences of t, never the first one. Magnitude depends on the token being output next, i.e. the token after t in the original. It is largest for e (the te bigram: precision 0.94, 60% of mass, and all top activations), then t (tt), then weaker for c, w and v. Within copy-phase t at recall >= 3 it fires on only about 7% of steps, so the broad condition has recall 0.96 but precision 0.07. The te/tt predicate trades recall for precision. Low-magnitude firings on t followed by other tokens are not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=t (+7.75), phase=2 & out_tok=e (+3.95), in_tok=t (+3.92), next_out=e (+3.59), out_tok=e (+3.56), phase=2 & out_tok=v (+3.01).
